purpose: Institutional bootstrap and authority router for agents beginning at status.fountain.coach.

freshness.rule: This document routes to authorities. Its snapshot date does not replace the freshness semantics of a linked authority. Read the linked source before making a current claim.

discovery.rule: These discovery routes are equivalent entry points to this same JSON router. If the canonical JSON cannot be read, the HTML projection must not be treated as the machine bootstrap. Apply bootstrap-unreachable and STOP.

company.name: Fountain Coach
company.reframeRelationship: Reframe ist die Flagship-Anwendung, nicht das Unternehmen als Ganzes.

authorityFor: public developer profile and continuity context
developerContinuity.note: Profile context is evidence, not a substitute for repository-specific authority.

languageSupport.strategy: English is the sole public language. German projections and the language-switch template are offline.

authorityFor: public capabilities, assets, products, markets, business models, evidence, risks, and strategic hypotheses
strategicBusinessArchitecture.formula: capability -> asset -> product or infrastructure -> market -> evidence
strategicBusinessArchitecture.boundary: This projection does not establish commercial availability, revenue, customer numbers, private runtime completeness, or hardware interoperability unless a linked authority explicitly does so.

authorityFor: public product fields and product boundaries
products.boundary: A product field is not automatically a released product. Resolve capability, executable, acceptance, and release status separately.

repositories.role: Canonical Git owner of complete published company Status, transparency and business-architecture website
authorityFor: published company and business status claims
public Status machine endpoints and schemas
repositories.publicationRule: Source Git approval is separate from EstatePublisher live deployment and HTTPS read-back.

repositories.role: Canonical Git owner of complete published Governance site and chapter/legal edition
Internal Reframe rule authoring and historical source proposals, not published Governance edition authority
Reframe runtime and MIDI2 GPU fabric
repositories.stopReason: Public governance is not runtime truth. required authority unavailable -> STOP.

repositories.role: public Book of Reframe projection and reviewed public reference
scenario contract and scenario transport kit
authorityFor: public scenario-kit contracts and transport surface
public workbench implementation and validation context

repositories.role: organisation-level index for reusable product and foundation kits
repositories.note: Examples are repository pointers, not a claim that every repository is a released product. Inspect each repository.

companyIdentity.authorityFor: public company identity and product distinction

productIntent.authorityFor: Reframe product intent, architecture decisions, normative target states, and refactoring governance

layers.PLANS.md: current or planned multi-step work and bounded implementation phases
layers.Tools/MCP/Environment: available external capabilities and execution environment; not governance truth

currentWork.authorityFor: current work queue and planned implementation
currentWork.rule: Do not copy a plan snapshot into this router. Read the owning PLANS.md and record its source revision or snapshot date.

liveAcceptance.authorityFor: independent AX, Window-ID/VRT, Store, telemetry, and scenario acceptance evidence

releasedSurface.authorityFor: named public release and publication boundary
releasedSurface.rule: live-accepted does not imply released; require a named release authority.

publicProjection.authorityFor: sanitized public explanation and routing only
publicProjection.rule: This bootstrap never overrides a repository, Store, contract, evidence, or release authority.

statusSemantics.exists: An identity or source is declared or discoverable. This does not prove availability or implementation.
statusSemantics.available: The declared capability or environment can be reached in the relevant context. This does not prove execution.
statusSemantics.executable: The declared contract can be run through its required procedure and environment. This does not prove live acceptance.
statusSemantics.live-accepted: The declared acceptance procedure passed with its independent AX/Window-ID/VRT, Store, telemetry, and provenance evidence.
statusSemantics.released: A named release authority has published the surface under its release boundary.
statusSemantics.authorityRule: Never promote one status to another by inference. Resolve each status from its owning authority.

procedures.name: Tools / MCP / Environment
procedures.rule: Capability presence is not permission, runtime truth, or evidence.

kinds.sourceRepository: supports public source and provenance claims
kinds.Store: supports persisted runtime behavior only when read from the owning Store
kinds.AX: supports accessible UI semantics and observed surface state
kinds.windowIdVRT: supports visual identity of the bound window; a screenshot alone is not behavioral proof
kinds.telemetry: supports emitted operational events and errors; logs alone do not prove success
kinds.provenance: binds claim to source revision, executable, process, Store, and evidence bundle

evidence.rule: Every claim names its authority and evidence. Different evidence kinds are not interchangeable.
evidence.publication: Before publication or promotion, run the repository's prepublication, link, accessibility, visual, and provenance gates.

publicPrivateBoundary.rule: A public projection may name a private authority and its boundary, but may not reconstruct or publish its contents.

stopConditions.when: The machine-readable bootstrap cannot be read from the canonical or declared discovery routes.
stopConditions.rule: Do not promote the human HTML projection into machine authority.

stopConditions.when: The required runtime authority cannot be reached.
The applicable AGENTS.md is missing, unread, or unresolved.
Two authorities conflict and the conflict cannot be resolved from the contract or live state.
The required Skill or procedure is unavailable.
The required execution environment or native capability is unavailable.
Required credentials are absent, locked, or not authorized.
A live claim lacks declared AX, Window-ID/VRT, Store, telemetry, and provenance evidence.
A release claim has no named release authority or release evidence.
A runtime defect cause is only inferred and owning code has not been inspected.
A private area would be reconstructed from a public projection.
Necessary evidence is unavailable or not bound to the claimed source revision.
